name: Fraying Sanity
oracle_text:
Enchant player
At the beginning of each end step, enchanted player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into their graveyard from anywhere this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each end step, enchanted player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into their graveyard from anywhere this turn.

needs.what: a value leaf counting the cards put into ONE player's graveyard from anywhere this turn, taking a player spec (here `enchanted_player`) -- a per-owner tally on TurnLedger beside the existing turn-wide `cards_to_graveyard`, cards only, tokens excluded, counting mills, discards, deaths and resolved spells
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cards_to_graveyard_this_turn` reads `TurnLedger.cards_to_graveyard`, a single integer over every graveyard that takes no player spec, so it would also count the controller's and other opponents' cards and mill far more than printed; `permanents_to_graveyard_this_turn` is table-wide and battlefield-only, and `count` over the graveyard counts cards already there before this turn
